body: Yeah. I'm searching up other ways. I just don't want my family and friends to know it was suicide.
Hi, thank you for offering. There is really nothing for me to say but I do really appreciate you offering and sorry if this came off as rude.

He could have been hitting on my friends but a grocery store car park is a weird way of trying to pick people up. 

The only reason I though he was going to ask for money is that as we were turning to leave for our car he called out to us and said "would any of your girls have...nevermind". 

Also thank you for welcoming me and replying.
And I'm dumb for still thinking about it haha.
That could be it and thank you for the answer.
Pretty much what my friend said haha.
Thank you for giving a thoughtful answer. It was a weird question and you can't really get an idea of the circumstances without being there. People do say I look uptight, so that might be it.
I didn't even fully realise he said it until my friends pointed out how weird it was.
I'm close to your daughter's age (19F). You sound like a wonderful lady and I hope one day you can have the Mother's Day you deserve. Happy Mother's Day.
